targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE span_name = 'graphiti.add_episode' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE span_name = 'graphiti.search' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE span_name = 'graphiti.llm.generate' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE span_name LIKE 'graphiti.episode.%write%' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
SELECT trace_id, span_name, duration_nano/1000000 AS duration_ms, timestamp FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE span_name LIKE 'graphiti.%' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT span_name, count(*) AS calls, round(avg(duration_nano)/1000000, 1) AS avg_ms, round(max(duration_nano)/1000000, 1) AS max_ms FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY span_name ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT trace_id, span_name, duration_nano/1000000 AS duration_ms, timestamp FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 30
